content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to switch between three images so that only one is visible at a time when they are placed in the same position? In the attached screenshot, it works as expected unless the images are stacked; then only the front image is visible.

You can use three switch buttons and remove the text for the ON and OFF states. For the OFF state, use a transparent image, like the provided 'Transparenz.png'. For the ON state, select the appropriate smiley image. Assign each switch the correct type and address. Finally, set identical X and Y positions for all three switch buttons.
Thank you, I will give that a try! 18-08-2021 Thanks, it's working perfectly now.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wanted to display and switch between three images at the same location, ensuring only one image is visible at any moment. Using transparent images for the OFF state on switch buttons made it possible for only the selected image to appear when they overlap.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to toggle among multiple images located at the same position, with only the chosen image displaying at any time.
